title: agentic-tools: add the simple-english skill
brief: Vendors the ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English skill as `agentic-tools/skills/simple-english` and registers it in the pack docs. Install it with `npx agentic-tools install simple-english`.

blocks.title: What this adds
blocks.body: `simple-english` makes an agent write, rewrite, review, and check technical documentation in **ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English**. It is vendored from [`0xpili/simplified-technical-english`](https://github.com/0xpili/simplified-technical-english) and renamed for a shorter install name.

entries.note: MIT for the skill text and script
ASD-STE100 word list stays ASD property

rows: Trigger + the verb, sentence, word, and safety rules
Optional Python 3 checker (rule numbers in output)
MIT text/script; ASD-STE100 dictionary stays ASD property

+## Vendored skills
+
+A skill can be copied from upstream instead of written here. Keep the source
+files verbatim, ship its `LICENSE`/`NOTICE.md` inside the skill directory so the
+attribution travels with `install`, and point at the upstream repo in the
+provenance note here. `simple-english` is vendored this way from

+
+Vendored verbatim from

blocks.summary: Frontmatter: the install name must match the directory.
blocks.code:
---
name: simple-english
description: Writes and rewrites text in Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100), a controlled language for clear technical documentation. Use when the user asks for STE, Simplified Technical English, controlled language, or plain technical writing, and when the user asks to write, rewrite, review, or check technical documentation, procedures, manuals, instructions, warnings, or reports.
license: MIT for the text of this skill. The word list in references/word-list.md comes from the ASD-STE100 dictionary, which is the property of ASD. Refer to NOTICE.md.
metadata:
  source-specification: ASD-STE100 Issue 7 (2017-01-25)
---

blocks.title: License scope
blocks.body: The skill text, references, examples, and script are **MIT**. The `references/word-list.md` comes from the **ASD-STE100 dictionary, which is ASD property**. `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md` are copied inside the skill directory so the attribution travels with `install`.
